item.title: PS PLUS Leak: March 2026 Lineup Rumored To Include PGA TOUR 2K25
item.description: A new leak claims that PGA Tour 2K25 will be the headline game for March 2026's PlayStation Plus lineup. It will be one of multiple games available for download next month.

item.title: TMNT: SPLINTERED FATE Adds Alopex As First Female Playable Character In New DLC
item.description: Super Evil Megacorp launches Alopex DLC for TMNT: Splintered Fate, introducing the mutant fox ninja as the game's first female hero, five new artifacts, and free updates on all platforms.

item.title: MARATHON: New Rook Cinematic Trailer Highlighting The Cybernetic Runner Drops Before Server Slam Beta
item.description: Bungie's latest Marathon trailer spotlights Rook, a cybernetic Runner scavenging Tau Ceti IV amid blue blood and tension. Server Slam beta starts February 26th, don't miss it.

item.title: ARC RAIDERS Shrouded Sky Update Is Hiding Something Big In The Skies
item.description: Players have uncovered something strange and enormous soaring through Arc Raiders' new Shrouded Sky hurricanes, absent from patch notes. Is this a tease for a flying boss Arc?

item.title: MORTAL KOMBAT II Trailer Makes An Unlikely Hero Out Of Karl Urban's Johnny Cage
item.description: A new trailer and poster for Mortal Kombat II are finally here, and with the stakes higher than ever, the spotlight is placed squarely on Karl Urban's Johnny Cage and some grizzly Fatalities.

item.title: PS PLUS: March 2026's Free PLAYSTATION PLUS Games For PS5 And PS4 Announced
item.description: Starting Tuesday, March 3rd, PlayStation Plus members will be able to add four games to their library for free, including PGA Tour 2K25, Monster Hunter Rise, and more.

item.title: MARVEL MAXIMUM COLLECTION Packs 13 Retro Marvel Game Versions Into One Massive Release
item.description: MARVEL MaXimum Collection brings six retro Marvel classics and 13 total arcade and console versions to modern platforms, complete with online play, bonus content, and quality of life upgrades.

item.title: LEGO BATMAN: LEGACY OF THE DARK KNIGHT Cinematic Recreates Iconic Museum Scene From 1989 BATMAN Movie
item.description: Warner Bros. Games has released a LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight cinematic, recreating the 1989 museum scene from DC's Batman movie in playful brick-built form.

item.title: HE-MAN AND THE MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE: DRAGON PEARL OF DESTRUCTION Retro Brawler Release Date Announced
item.description: Limited Run Games has announced that He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction, a retro-inspired 2D brawler, will launch for consoles and PC in April.
